audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] told the user to save Wind Wall for 'his W-charge or Path Maker (R) knockback line' — wrong slot and wrong mechanic.
audit.why: Path Maker is K'Sante's W, not his R; his R is All Out. Path Maker is a charged dash that knocks back and stuns and deals true damage — it is not a projectile, so Wind Wall cannot stop it, and armour does not reduce it. Ntofo Strikes (Q) is his only projectile.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall stops Ntofo Strikes (Q) only. Path Maker (W) is a 14s true-damage dash that passes through it.

audit.whatIsWrong: win[]/phases[].side contradicted the whys[] on the same page at rows 3, 5 and 6.
audit.why: whys[2] already said level 3 is 'an even skill fight' while win[2] said K'Sante; whys[4] said All Out gives him lethal burst while win[4] said Skill; whys[5] said your first crit item out-trades his tank profile while win[5] said K'Sante. The packet chart and the mirror both agree with the whys.
audit.corrected: Row 3 to Skill, row 5 to K'Sante, row 6 to Yasuo — matched full/content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike advice named no cooldowns anywhere.
audit.why: All Out is 120/100/80s, Path Maker is 14s at rank 1, Ntofo Strikes is a flat 3.5s and pulls on the second stack. Those numbers are what make 'fight when it's down' actionable.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns written into dosFull[0].d, dosFull[1].d, breakdown.cooldowns and spikes[0].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was recommended but attributed to nothing, and nothing warned that armour is the wrong stat.
audit.why: All Out (R) grants K'Sante healing — that is the Grievous Wounds target. Separately, Path Maker (W) deals true damage, so stacking armour reads the trade wrong. Plated Steelcaps was the recommended boot against a kit whose scariest damage ignores armour.
audit.corrected: Itemization now names All Out for the anti-heal and swaps the boot reasoning to his stuns; the true-damage warning is in dontsFull[2].d.

edits.after: Full kit online and it evens out: your E-Q spacing answers the Ntofo Strikes pull, his Path Maker answers your step-up.

notes: The page had Path Maker labelled as K'Sante's R (it is his W) and told the user Wind Wall could block it — it is a dash with true damage and passes straight through. Also worth noting the level chart was internally inconsistent before this: three rows of win[] flatly contradicted the whys[] printed next to them, and in every case the whys were the correct read. Anti-heal here is genuinely correct (All Out heals), unlike the identical boilerplate line on the Kled page where it is not.
